_comment: Approximate, rounded literature values for educational use only. Concentrations are plasma concentrations; mg/L equals ug/mL. dose_conversion converts mg of the administered dose to the amount unit of the concentration (1.0 for mg->mg; lithium carbonate -> mmol Li+). t_half_h, F and vd_l_per_kg describe a 70 kg adult with normal renal function; vd_l_per_kg and ka_per_h are fitted so that AUC/steady-state level, Cmax and Tmax match published data (see reference_pk.json). cv_cl / cv_f: inter-individual CV of clearance / bioavailability (log-normal). elimination.pathways: fraction of clearance carried by each pathway (CYP/UGT/CES1 enzyme name, 'renal' for unchanged urinary excretion, or another non-CYP route); the unassigned remainder is unaffected by genotype. Only encoded where a label mass balance or concordant in-vivo data supports it - drugs without it behave as before. fe_renal is the 'renal' entry and both spellings stay in sync. metabolite: one active metabolite formed from the parent's clearance; 'reported' says whether the preset's concentrations and window mean the parent, the metabolite, or their potency-weighted sum. protein_binding.fu: unbound fraction, recorded for reference only - every therapeutic range here is a total plasma concentration, so no prediction depends on fu. saturable: Michaelis-Menten km (concentration unit) and the saturable share of low-concentration clearance. two_compartment: central volume as a fraction of vd_l and inter-compartmental clearance Q (L/h, 70 kg). tlag_h: oral absorption lag. formulations: selectable product forms (e.g. prolonged release) overriding bioavailability, ka_per_h, tlag_h and the default regimen; the first entry is the default. enzyme_inactivation: mechanism-based inactivation of the enzyme carrying 'fraction' of clearance (kinact 1/h, KI in the concentration unit, kdeg = enzyme turnover 1/h); t_half_h is then the half-life once the enzyme is inactivated. t_half_range_h is the published half-life range (used for the band only when cv_cl is missing).

protein_binding.note: Over 99% bound; binding is nonlinear and stereoselective.

drugs.name: Paracetamol (acetaminophen)

elimination.note: Label mass balance: 'approximately 50% is glucuronidated and excreted in the urine, approximately 40% is sulfated ... approximately 5% is excreted in the urine unchanged'. The CYP2E1 share rises to about 50% in overdose, which this model does not cover.

drugs.notes: MTC is a conservative modelling threshold; hepatotoxicity risk is dose- and time-dependent (acute overdose is assessed with the Rumack-Matthew nomogram).

drugs.name: Amoxicillin

elimination.note: Label: 'approximately 60% to 80% of the dose being excreted unchanged in urine'. The fraction falls with dose as absorption saturates (0.50 at 97 mg to 0.23 at 3103 mg), so this single value suits ordinary doses only.

drugs.notes: Time-dependent killing: efficacy tracks time above the pathogen MIC. MEC here is an illustrative MIC for susceptible organisms; the upper limit is an arbitrary educational reference (wide therapeutic index).

drugs.name: Lithium (carbonate)

elimination.note: Not metabolised; excreted essentially entirely unchanged by the kidney. About 80% of filtered lithium is reabsorbed in the proximal tubule, which is why sodium and volume depletion raise levels.

drugs.dose_basis: mg lithium carbonate (1 mg = 0.02707 mmol Li+)
drugs.notes: Maintenance window 0.6-1.2 mmol/L (trough, 12 h post-dose); toxicity above 1.5 mmol/L. The MTC used for the red zone is 1.5; levels of 1.2-1.5 are flagged as the upper edge of the window.

drugs.name: Diazepam

metabolite.name: Nordazepam (N-desmethyldiazepam)
metabolite.note: N-desmethyldiazepam (nordazepam), the one major active metabolite. The fraction of a diazepam dose converted was not found in the literature, so it is fitted: 0.761 is the value at which the steady-state nordazepam:diazepam ratio reproduces the measured 1.26 (n=110 on chronic dosing, r=0.80). It is therefore calibrated, not observed. Half-life 65 h (mean after intravenous clorazepate; reviews span 36-200 h and labels say 'up to 100 h'), Vd 1.24 L/kg, molar factor 284.74/270.71. reported='parent' keeps this preset's meaning and its 0.2-0.8 ug/mL window unchanged - nordazepam is shown as a second curve only. Its potency relative to diazepam could not be sourced quantitatively, so no potency-weighted sum is offered.

protein_binding.note: Strongly albumin-bound; the free fraction rises with age. The often-quoted 98-99% could not be confirmed directly.

elimination.note: Two concordant in-vivo lines give fm(CYP2C19) about 0.5: CYP2C19 poor metabolisers show roughly twice the AUC, and omeprazole reduces clearance by about 55%. An in-vitro study reporting 3-hydroxylation (CYP3A4) as 90% of metabolism appears to conflict, but it measures relative formation rates at one concentration rather than the fraction of in-vivo clearance; the in-vivo evidence is preferred here.

drugs.notes: Nordazepam, the active metabolite (t1/2 about 65 h), is simulated as a second curve; the reported concentration and the therapeutic window remain those of diazepam itself.

drugs.name: Livizux (lisdexamfetamin)
drugs.dose_basis: mg lisdexamfetamin dimesilát (Livizux), 1 mg LDX ≈ 0.294 mg d-amfetaminu
drugs.notes: Lisdexamfetamin dimesilát (Livizux). Proléčivo aktivního d-amfetaminu na ADHD. Užívá se 1× denně ráno. Enzymatická hydrolýza v krvi zajišťuje pozvolný nástup (Tmax cca 3.5–4 h) a trvání účinku 12–14 h. AGNP terapeutické rozmezí d-amfetaminu 20–80 ng/mL (0.02–0.08 µg/mL).

drugs.name: Levetiracetam (Keppra)

elimination.note: Label mass balance: 'renal excretion of unchanged drug accounts for 66% of the administered dose', plus the carboxylic acid metabolite ucb L057 (24% of dose) formed by non-CYP hydrolysis. Corrects an earlier fe_renal of 0.75.

drugs.notes: Levetiracetam (Keppra). Téměř 100% perorální biologická dostupnost. Terapeutické monitorování dle AGNP doporučení 12–46 µg/mL.

drugs.name: Pregabalin

protein_binding.note: Does not bind to plasma proteins.

elimination.note: Label: 'approximately 90% of the administered dose was recovered in the urine as unchanged pregabalin'. Corrects an earlier 0.98, which was the percentage of urinary radioactivity rather than of the dose.

drugs.notes: Vysoká biologická dostupnost (≥ 90 %), lineární kinetika, minimální vazba na bílkoviny plazmy. Terapeutické rozmezí dle AGNP 2.0–5.0 µg/mL, toxicita > 8.0 µg/mL.

drugs.name: Propranolol

protein_binding.note: About 90% bound to albumin and alpha-1-acid glycoprotein; AGP-driven and variable.

drugs.notes: Neselektivní lipofilní beta-blokátor. Výrazný jaterní first-pass efekt (F ≈ 25 %, mezi pacienty silně kolísá – CV expozice cca 50 %). Zdánlivý distribuční objem 2.7 L/kg je nafitován na publikované Cmax/AUC po 40–80 mg (IV hodnota cca 4 L/kg). Terapeutické rozmezí 20–100 ng/mL (0.02–0.10 µg/mL), toxicita > 0.20 µg/mL. Forma s prodlouženým uvolňováním (Inderal LA a obdoby): pomalé vstřebávání (Tmax cca 6 h) a nižší expozice, ustálená AUC odpovídá cca 60–65 % stejné denní dávky v dělených dávkách běžné formy.

drugs.name: Rivotril (clonazepam)
drugs.notes: Klonazepam (Rivotril). Dlouhý poločas rozpadu (30–40 h), silná akumulace v ustáleném stavu. Terapeutické rozmezí dle AGNP 20–70 ng/mL (0.02–0.07 µg/mL), toxicita > 0.08 µg/mL.

drugs.name: Mirtazapin

elimination.note: Reaction phenotyping (Stormer 2000): 8-hydroxylation 55 % of metabolism with CYP2D6 contributing about 65 % of it, N-demethylation 35 % (CYP3A4), N-oxidation 10 %. Medium confidence, because the CYP2D6 share is concentration-dependent (65 % at 2 uM falling to 20 % at 250 uM) - therapeutic levels sit below the tested range, so the CYP2D6 fraction here is if anything conservative. The fractions are supported independently by the mechanistic back-test, which reproduces this drug's measured carbamazepine and ketoconazole interactions to within 1.30x and 1.01x.

drugs.notes: Noradrenergní a specifické serotonergní antidepresivum (NaSSA). Dávkování jednou denně večer. Zdánlivý distribuční objem (10.5 L/kg) je nafitován na ustálené hladiny pacientů (medián cca 37 ng/mL při 30 mg/den); jednokompartmentový model proto podhodnocuje vrchol po první dávce. AGNP terapeutické rozmezí 30–80 ng/mL (0.03–0.08 µg/mL), toxické hladiny > 0.15 µg/mL.

drugs.name: Risperidon

elimination.note: Parent risperidone is CYP2D6-dominant: fraction 0.78 derived from CATIE population clearances of 65.4, 36 and 12.9 L/h in extensive, intermediate and poor metabolisers. Note that the ACTIVE MOIETY is nevertheless CYP2D6-independent - the label states that combined risperidone plus 9-OH kinetics are similar in extensive and poor metabolisers, because less metabolite forms but the parent is cleared more slowly. The model reproduces that buffering automatically, since 9-OH formation is itself the CYP2D6 route.

metabolite.name: 9-hydroxyrisperidon (paliperidon)
metabolite.note: 9-hydroxyrisperidone (paliperidone). Parent and metabolite are simulated separately and the reported concentration is their sum, which is the active moiety the AGNP 20-60 ng/mL range refers to - so the window keeps its meaning. Parent half-life 3 h and metabolite 21 h are label values for extensive metabolisers. Formation fraction 0.78 is the parent's CYP2D6 fraction derived from CATIE population clearances. Volumes are solved jointly from the AGNP steady-state level and the reported 9-OH:parent AUC ratio of about 5; the parent volume that falls out, 1.55 L/kg, sits inside the label's stated 1-2 L/kg, which is an independent check rather than an imposed constraint. The unweighted sum is a convention: 9-OH is described as comparable in potency to risperidone, not measured equipotent.

protein_binding.note: Risperidone 90% bound, 9-hydroxyrisperidone 77%; the free fraction rises about 35% in hepatic impairment.

drugs.notes: Atypické antipsychotikum. Risperidon a jeho metabolit 9-hydroxyrisperidon jsou modelovány zvlášť; vykazovanou veličinou zůstává jejich součet (aktivní frakce), ke kterému se vztahuje terapeutické okno. AGNP terapeutické rozmezí 20–60 ng/mL (0.02–0.06 µg/mL), riziko EPS > 0.08 µg/mL. Variabilita mezi pacienty (cv_cl 1.08) je odvozena z publikovaného cca 20násobného rozpětí ustálených hladin aktivní frakce (1,8–36,8 nmol/l na mg/den): odpovídá log-SD 0,91, z čehož genotyp CYP2D6 vysvětluje jen 0,23, tedy asi 6 % rozptylu; zbytek je variabilita v rámci fenotypu.

drugs.name: Ritalin (methylfenidát)

elimination.note: Label mass balance: about 80% of the dose is excreted as ritalinic acid formed by carboxylesterase CES1, under 1% unchanged. Essentially no CYP involvement. CES1 hydrolysis is stereoselective for l-methylphenidate, which is why d-methylphenidate dominates in plasma.

drugs.notes: Methylfenidát-hydrochlorid (Ritalin). Krátkodobě působící stimulans CNS indikované při ADHD a narkolepsii. Rychlá absorpce (Tmax 1–2 h), nízká perorální biologická dostupnost racemátu (F ≈ 15 %; d-MPH 22 %, l-MPH 5 %) vlivem first-pass metabolismu. Krátký biologický poločas eliminace (t½ cca 2–3 h) vyžaduje podávání 2–3× denně (interval 6–8 h, obvykle ráno a v poledne). AGNP doporučené terapeutické rozmezí 5–20 ng/mL (0.005–0.020 µg/mL), nežádoucí a toxické hladiny > 0.030 µg/mL.

drugs.name: MDMA (ecstasy)
drugs.notes: MDMA (3,4-methylendioxymetamfetamin). Nástup účinku perorálně 30–60 min (Tmax cca 2 h), nosně 5–15 min. Nelineární kinetika: MDMA nevratně inaktivuje vlastní enzym CYP2D6 (obnova trvá cca 10 dní, poločas obnovy cca 47 h). Druhá dávka proto zvýší hladinu výrazně víc než prostý součet: o cca 17 % při odstupu 2–4 h a AUC druhé dávky o cca 65–77 % i po 24 h. t½ cca 11 h platí po inaktivaci enzymu, tj. po každé běžné dávce. Riziko hypertermie a hyponatrémie; doporučeno nekombinovat s jinými stimulancii a inhibitory MAO/SSRI.

drugs.name: Ketamin

protein_binding.note: About 47% bound in human plasma; pH- and AGP-dependent.

drugs.notes: Ketamin. Výrazný first-pass efekt při perorálním užití (F ≈ 20 %). Nosní aplikace poskytuje F ≈ 50 % s rychlým nástupem (5–10 min). Nekombinovat s tlumivými látkami (alkohol, opioidy, benzodiazepiny).
